verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce's evidence is about enabling external AI agents (ChatGPT, coding agents, Link CLI) to transact via Stripe's APIs/MCP server — it is infrastructure that other agents call into, not a built-in assistant inside Stripe's own product that an end user can delegate tasks to. No evidence pack item describes a first-party embedded assistant/chat UI within Stripe itself for users to delegate work to.
